title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Memorial Tournament Purse
items.text: The Memorial Tournament now ranks among the highest purses on the PGA Tour alongside the Masters and PGA Championship.

items.headline: Dustin Johnson's Hole-in-One
items.text: Dustin Johnson made a hole-in-one on the third hole in round three at LIV Golf Andalucía, shooting a 7-under 64 to reach T-4, five shots behind Tyrrell Hatton going into the final round.
